card.name: Partway through names with zo/zol
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the piece "ZO" or "ol" partway through a brand or drug name, such as MYQORZO, INLEXZO, dorzolamide and Lorenzo or soranzo. It fires before the rest of the name continues.

modes.label: Brand names ending in ZO
modes.description: The capitalized ending ZO in newer brand names like MYQORZO and INLEXZO.

modes.label: Inside dorzolamide
modes.description: The "ol" piece inside the drug name dorzolamide.

modes.label: Personal names with zo
modes.description: The "o" or "Lorenzo" piece in personal names in author lists or research credits.
modes.example: Shin S-Y, Richards HB, soranz<<o>> N, Ahmadi KR, Ling

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of certain drug and person names that contain "zo" or "zol", such as MYQORZO and dorzolamide.
